notes: Canonical trajectories contain observable structured decision traces, not raw hidden chain-of-thought.
Leak-free splitting groups task/repository/trajectory families before training transformation.
Explicit held-out task families cannot enter training transformation.
Confidence is evidence-bound; contradictory evidence stops even under high confidence.
Self-correction requires changed-basis replanning rather than blind retry.
This foundation does not claim a real trace-corpus import, SFT run, or post-training improvement.
